D071.body:
@startuml
!define PRODUCT mdvu
!$version = "1.2026.9"
!include <archimate/Archimate>
title PRODUCT — stdlib / preprocessor probe
Application_Component(app, "mdvu")
!$runtimeLabel = "PlantUML " + $version
Technology_Service(runtime, $runtimeLabel)
Rel_Serving_Up(runtime, app, "renders")
@enduml
D071.reason: ArchiMate unquoted procedures require a precomputed argument; the runtime label is assigned before Technology_Service is called. Original five fixtures are unchanged.

comparisonSelection.rule: One example per engine and distinct diagram grammar or library view. Aliases, layout/style/feature probes and repeated examples are excluded; distinct Mermaid and PlantUML syntaxes remain separate. Runtime information and Creole formatting are not diagrams.
